worldcombat.skill.blastburn.summary: The user compresses fire into a hot core and hurls it at a point, where it detonates and razes everything in range; the blast leaves the user overheated for a while, unable to act or move.
The detonation deals %1$s special damage to every enemy in the radius.
The blast radius is %1$s blocks; each caught target has a %2$s chance to catch fire, burning for %3$s.
Afterwards the user is overheated for %1$s, unable to act or move.
The core flies up to %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick; the wind-up is %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.blastburn.use.1: Burn several clustered targets at once
worldcombat.skill.blastburn.use.2: Trade one overheat for a cleared area
worldcombat.skill.blastburn.preference.s: The radius of fire at the landing point. Wider covers more targets at once, but each takes less damage and the overheat lasts longer; tighter concentrates the blast and recovers sooner, but only burns near the point.
worldcombat.skill.blastburn.preference.a: How many enemies must be near the landing point before the user detonates. Higher saves the big blast for clusters; at 1 it fires at a single target too.
Below this health fraction the user stops starting detonations (unless it can cover three or more targets). Higher avoids leaving an overheated opening.
worldcombat.skill.blastburn.timing: Slower wind-up, longer recovery; the overheat settles after a single detonation.
worldcombat.skill.blastburn.growth.0: From level 36 the blast gains another step with level.
